title: Fix Release workflow (release-plz): PR creation blocked, orphan branches spam

comments.author: home
comments.text: Diagnosis (attempt B): the Release workflow (release.yml) has failed on all 47 runs. Failure: release-plz pushes a `chore: release vX.Y.Z` branch, then fails to open the release PR with HTTP 403 from `POST /repos/AnthusAI/BotSpy/pulls`: "GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests." Repo Actions setting `can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false` (Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions) blocks GITHUB_TOKEN from creating PRs. Side effect: 46 orphaned `release-plz-<timestamp>` branches, one per failed run. Publishing config is fine: release-plz.toml publish=false, so no CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN needed. Trigger (push to main only) is correct for GitFlow. Fix: pre-flight permission check that skips release-plz with an explicit warning when PR creation is blocked; release-plz.toml semver_check=false (crate never published to crates.io, registry semver baseline unavailable).
